identity.title: CVE-2026-113781
identity.description: ESP-IDF is the Espressif Internet of Things (IoT) Development Framework. Prior to 5.2.8, 5.3.6, 5.5.6, and 6.0.3, the Bluedroid BLE Mesh GATT server read handler bt_mesh_bta_gatts_cb in esp_ble_mesh stores a signed attribute-read callback length in an unsigned 16-bit variable. A negative ATT error code is therefore interpreted as a very large successful length and used for a memory copy from a small stack buffer into the GATT response structure.
